Goliath Culture

High in the mountains, where the air is thin and the wind never stops, Goliath clans live by competition: every hunt, climb, and supper is a chance to outdo yesterday. Fenari who settle among them take to this with enthusiasm, if not always with dignity.

Over the generations these Fenari grow larger and stockier than any of their kin. Their fur thickens against the cold, often in stone grays and snowy whites, and some develop faint markings that echo the lithoderms of the Goliaths around them.

Goliath Fenari keep careful score of everything: the heaviest stone lifted, the steepest climb, the most impressive thing found in someone else's pack. They're fiercely proud of their place in the clan and will cheerfully challenge creatures three times their size to prove they deserve it.

Alignment. Goliath Fenari tend toward lawful neutral.

Fenari Traits

  • Size. Living among Goliaths has made these Fenari larger than their kin, most growing between 4'8" and 5'6" tall and weighing 100 to 150 pounds. Your size is Medium.
  • Creature Type. Humanoid
  • Speed. 30 feet
  • Darkvision. You can see in Dim Light within 60 feet of you as if it were Bright Light, and in Darkness as if it were Dim Light.
  • Enhanced Senses. You have proficiency in the Perception skill.
  • Bite. Your fanged maw is a natural weapon you can use to make Unarmed Strikes, dealing 1d6 + your Strength modifier Piercing damage on a hit.
  • Languages. Common and Giant.
  • Compact Power. You count as one size larger for carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

See the The Fenari journal for the Fenari's history, Creed, and appearance.
